newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ says has no comment on media report on rates.
newsitem.headline: BOJ says has no comment on media report on rates.

text.p: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) has no comment on a media report on Friday that the central bank is worried about an excessive fall in long-term interest rates, a BOJ spokesman told Reuters.
Jiji news agency reported earlier that the BOJ was worried that long-term interest rates are falling excessively.
Jiji said the yield on key Japanese government bonds has temporarily dropped to the 2.7 percent level.
